name: Ligus 2.1.0
notes: Features: workspace guards (dearth mode with a visible banner and two-Admin joins, one sandbox envelope for every agent runtime with secret redaction, chat lockdown on an infection signal, coordinator leases so exactly one device drives a workflow run, staggered plan-window throttles that always leave room for your own requests, hygiene sweeps and growth suggestions); proposal sets for exploring options, with blind scout assessments, decaying support, a quorum dial and a pre-flight before apply; and Flow: hand-off cards and context parcels, outcome-weighted routing in shadow mode, review-queue backpressure, a task board, workspace marks, path zones that set the review bar, reused turn worktrees and a home beacon.
